title: QuotesDone Accountant Knowledge v1
generated_at_load: public.gl_accounts  -> one QD-ACC-COA-<code> record per chart-of-accounts row
public.company_registration -> QD-ACC-POSITION-* records carrying the company's own tax position
never_runtime: scripts/kb/accountant_knowledge_retrieval_eval.mjs holds the evaluation questions and their expected records. It is a SCRIPT, not a record file, it is not named in runtime_files, and the loader refuses any path that is not records/*.jsonl. The estate has a documented defect where exam answers leaked into the corpus an agent retrieves and 557 rows had to be quarantined; keeping the questions in executable code rather than in a data file is what stops that recurring here.

epistemic_contract.authority_effect: none on every record, CHECK-pinned in the table. A record may DESCRIBE authority. It may never CARRY it.
epistemic_contract.no_figures_rule: No record in this pack states a tax rate, a filing deadline, a penalty amount, a retention period in years, or a registration threshold figure other than the one already recorded by the company itself in public.company_registration. Where a figure is needed the record says how to obtain it from the current applicable authority.
epistemic_contract.not_a_cpa: This body is authored professional method plus the shape of UAE obligations. It is not a certified accounting qualification and no record claims to be.
